content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I thoroughly enjoy taking the time to understand my customer’s goals, both short and long term to help them achieve success. I like to educate them as to the best options that would fit their needs and give them the tools to make the appropriate decision.

I enjoy the teamwork and comradery with our entire team at Averon Trust. I love working for an organization that is so respected and giving to our community.

A Little About Me

I joined the Averon Trust team in 2000 and have been helping our customers reach their goals, whether big or small, ever since.

I am a proud East Lyme High School graduate and I love to volunteer with sweat equity. In the past, I have been involved in the Niantic Rotary and I am currently on the board of Niantic Main Street. 

I have been named Woman on Fire, have received a Paul Harris Award, and have received the George Strouse Spirit Award. 

In my personal life, I have been blessed with a grandson and granddaughter who live only a ½ a mile from us. I absolutely adore being a Nona and spending as much time with our family as I can.
